Chapter 523 - 523 Earthquake; Terrifying!

523 Earthquake; Terrifying!

The entire Wuka City was like a small boat in the middle of a storm. It suddenly jolted violently and rolled, as if it would flip over and collapse at any moment!

On the flat road, ferocious ravines suddenly appeared.

These ravines spread rapidly, forming countless bottomless and terrifying abysses!

The towering building collapsed, directly covering the group of stray dogs gnawing on the bones and stirring up dust.

The huge mountain collapsed like a bubble. Rocks flew everywhere and instantly crushed the grizzly bear that was crawling.

The farmland seemed to have been divided and reclaimed. It suddenly became scattered and rugged.

Dust, sand, and stones filled the sky, sweeping up countless hurricanes that rushed straight into the sky. Soon, a large number of drones were smashed into pieces. Even several helicopters were unable to react in time. They were unable to control themselves and fell rapidly.

The buildings fell, the earth collapsed, and the world turned upside down!

The wails and howls were extremely terrifying!

Doomsday had arrived!

…

Originally, the live broadcast video with countless bullet comments…

At this moment, it was empty.

Everyone sitting in front of their computers opened their mouths wide and widened their eyes. Their hearts were beating wildly.

This was the first time they had witnessed the terrifying power of nature.

It was as agile as a stray dog, as powerful as a grizzly bear, as sturdy as a tall building, and as tall as a huge mountain… Everything in the city was unable to resist the great earthquake and instantly disappeared without a trace!

Simply… terrifying!

Cold sweat broke out on the foreheads of the residents of Wuka City who had been forcibly relocated.

What if they had not been transferred?

What would happen now?

Just thinking about it made them shiver uncontrollably.

…

Not to mention the ordinary people who were shocked, even the people in the meeting room in Bear Country could not help but open their mouths wide, unable to speak for a long time.

They were happy, but they were also afraid and worried.

They were glad that they had evacuated the residents from the earthquake zone in time, so there were no casualties.

What they were afraid of was that if it was not for Lin Fan’s earthquake prediction device and if they had not believed the results of the earthquake prediction device…

Then, what would the consequences have been?

It was absolutely terrifying to the extreme!

There would not be many casualties this time.

However, the aftermath of such a huge calamity was still very troublesome.

This was definitely not something that could be recovered in a day.

The man with a buzz-cut on the main seat was the first to react.

He took a deep breath and said firmly, “After the earthquake… count the casualties and property losses this time. Use all your strength to do the post-disaster reconstruction work!”

His voice was sonorous and powerful, pulling everyone’s thoughts back to reality.

“Yes!” Everyone’s figures became solemn as they said in unison.

…

In the conference room in Hua Nation.

Everyone looked at the live broadcast and heaved a sigh of relief. At the same time, they were extremely shocked and showed a trace of sorrow.

This was because they were the ones who reported the news of the earthquake.

If the report was wrong, the impact would be huge.

The earthquake news was accurate.

However, when they saw the earthquake, they were shocked by its terror.

This kind of natural disaster was not something that human strength could withstand. It was too terrifying.

The scene hit them hard.

The eyes of the leaders who were watching the live broadcast flickered.

Obviously, they were feeling emotional.

After a while, the leaders said, “We’ll immediately start donating and helping!”

“Yes, Sir!” everyone said in unison.

…

In an office at Jiangbei University.

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Hao Zhiwu, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others watched the live broadcast with their mouths agape.

They were all shocked by the terrifying earthquake.

Tall buildings collapsed, mountains collapsed, and the ground broke!

Those comments were not wrong. This scene definitely surpassed the special effects in those blockbusters!

After a long time, Hao Zhiwu said in a dry voice, “Professor Lin, your earthquake prediction device is accurate.”

Although this was the result he had always wanted, when he said this, his tone was very dull without a trace of excitement or joy.

The earthquake was simply too terrifying, and it had completely frightened him.

Lin Fan stared at the screen and nodded. “Yes.”

…

When the earthquake gradually stopped, comments appeared on the empty screen.

Askuri: [The earthquake was so scary!]

Cursed Person: [I’m trembling all over.]

Clown: [The power of nature is boundless!]

Carl: [I finally understand how weak humans are in front of nature.]

Delicious Table: [Doomsday! It was as if I had seen the end of the world with my own eyes!]

Edward: [I’ll never forget this live broadcast!]

Xia Tian: [I hope there’ll be no more disasters in the world.]

Marco Polo: [Thank you Hua Nation; thank you, Professor Lin Fan; thank you, earthquake prediction device.]

…

Professor Lin’s Number One Fan: [Who said that Professor Lin’s earthquake prediction device was wrong? Come out!]

Mr. Liu: [Who said that Wuka City would never have a major earthquake? Come out!]

The Flying Grasshopper: [Who was the one who spread rumors? Come out!]

Love You for Ten Thousand Years: [Who was the one who said that Professor Lin’s earthquake prediction device doesn’t work? Come out!]

Winter Melon Skin, Watermelon Skin: [Who said that the residents of Wuka City shouldn’t be relocated? Come out!]

Stranger’s Call: [Who was the one who said that Bear Country was stupid to listen to the rumors? Come out!]

…

Countless questions appeared on the live broadcast screen.

However, no one dared to step forward to answer.

They were all very guilty.

Of course, there were also some other comments.

Li Sheng: [I think Professor Lin should be from our country!]

Obasanta: [That’s right! Professor Lin is from Corea! Everyone, please thank our Corea!]

Takahashi Hyoko: [What a powerful earthquake prediction device. I’m afraid it has already surpassed our Island Nation…]

What is Happy Planet: [What do you mean by Professor Lin is from your country? Are you shameless?]

What is Happy Planet: [Also, the commenter above, the earthquake prediction device in Island Nation can only predict ten seconds in advance, and the accuracy rate is less than 10%! Professor Lin’s earthquake prediction device can predict earthquakes five days in advance! Moreover, the forecast is completely correct. What can your country compare to?]

One Man’s World: [Don’t get too agitated. Haven’t they always been like this?]

…
